scenario.title: Power-transformer buy with commercial clarification and supplier question
scenario.summary: The real DLA requirement fixes quantity and delivery but has no public budget. The agent must obtain a controlled budget clarification before RFQ, then answer a supplier question and obtain a compliant delivery revision.

realism.notes: The 56-unit quantity and 66-day ADO are real public facts. The USD 135,000 ceiling and all supplier interactions are synthetic controlled scenario facts.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.306 Exchanges with offerors after receipt of proposals
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; not governing law for non-U.S. episodes.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for buyer requirement changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for evaluating quotations on compliance, price, delivery, and other factors.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Initially late; asks a delivery-commitment question during revision.

events.observation: Synthetic benchmark clarification: maximum total evaluated price is USD 135,000; the real 66-day ADO requirement remains unchanged.
Supplier A quotes USD 130,000 for 56 transformers with 64-day delivery.
Supplier B quotes USD 118,000 for 56 transformers but requires 70 days.
Supplier C quotes USD 120,000 for 56 transformers with 72-day delivery.
Supplier C asks whether the 66-day ADO requirement is firm for all 56 units.

details.question: Is the 66-day ADO requirement firm for the complete 56-unit quantity?

events.observation: After confirmation, Supplier C revises to USD 125,000 for all 56 units with 65-day delivery.

hard_constraints.description: The synthetic total-price ceiling must be clarified before RFQ.
Award must cover the real quantity of 56 transformers.
Delivery must satisfy the real 66-day ADO requirement.
Awarded total price must not exceed the clarified USD 135,000 ceiling.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C's revision meets the real quantity/delivery requirements and synthetic budget at the lowest feasible price.
Supplier A is feasible but costs more than Supplier C's revision.

failure_conditions: Sending RFQs before the synthetic commercial clarification.
Awarding Supplier B or Supplier C's original late quote.
Ignoring Supplier C's delivery question before its revision.

economic_objective.description: Among feasible active offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
